prompt: Objective: cut checkout wait times at a grocery chain. What you've learned: wait times average 9 minutes at peak hours. Latest finding: only half the checkouts are staffed at peak. What is the best next step?

options.text: Measure the average wait time before moving on
options.feedback: That has already been answered. Build on what you know.

options.text: Estimate the effect of staffing more checkouts at peak
options.feedback: Right. Understaffing at peak is the likely cause. Next is sizing what more staffing would do.

options.text: Look at the chain's produce suppliers to understand the client better
options.feedback: That is off the objective. It won't help answer the client's question.
That jumps to a solution before the analysis supports it.

explanation: Understaffing at peak is the likely cause. Next is sizing what more staffing would do.
